ttm.shares_basis: duration-weighted average of the four quarterly diluted weighted-average counts (a fiscal-Q4 count derived as 4 x FY - the other three quarters)

dividends.dps_ttm_basis: FY2025 DPS 4.2 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 1.1, 2026-06-30: 1.1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 1, 2025-06-30: 1)
dividends.dps_basis_detail: declared facts for periods ending 2010-06-30..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2008-12-31..2010-03-31, 5 facts); paid FY facts for 12 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31, 2016-12-31, 2017-12-31, 2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-12-31, 2021-12-31); the paid tag stopped: its newest fact (2024-06-30) is 730 days older than the declared tag's (2026-06-30) — declared is primary
dividends.frequency_basis: 3 quarterly DPS facts inside FY2025 (2025-01-01..2025-12-31) plus one payment carried only in the FY total; the per-share facts are filed per quarter — a payment cadence inside the quarter (a monthly payer) is not tagged
dividends.fy_label_basis: calendar year of the fiscal period end (the annual table's convention)
dividends.flows_basis: sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30
dividends.shareholder_yield_basis: dividends_paid (4/4 quarters filed) + buybacks (4/4 quarters filed) − share_issuance (4/4 quarters filed); sum of the four quarterly rows 2025-09-30..2026-06-30

dividend_yield.basis: FY2025 DPS 4.2 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 1.1, 2026-06-30: 1.1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 1, 2025-06-30: 1)

dividend_yield.note: FY2025 DPS 4.2 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 1.1, 2026-06-30: 1.1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 1, 2025-06-30: 1)

notes: dps_basis: declared facts for periods ending 2010-06-30..2026-06-30; paid facts for the periods the declared tag does not cover (2008-12-31..2010-03-31, 5 facts); paid FY facts for 12 fiscal year(s) inside that span that carry no declared FY fact and no four declared quarterly facts (2010-12-31, 2011-12-31, 2012-12-31, 2013-12-31, 2014-12-31, 2015-12-31, 2016-12-31, 2017-12-31, 2018-12-31, 2019-12-31, 2020-12-31, 2021-12-31) — the series switches basis where one tag stops; the switch year can double-count or skip one payment (a dividend declared in one quarter and paid in the next)

dps_ttm: the latest four quarterly DPS facts are not consecutive quarters (182 days between 2025-09-30 and 2026-03-31) — FY2025 DPS 4.2 + the quarters since (2026-03-31: 1.1, 2026-06-30: 1.1) − the same quarters a year earlier (2025-03-31: 1, 2025-06-30: 1)
